data.content: The Harbour Bridge opened in March 1932 after eight years of construction. It carries eight lanes of road traffic and two railway lines. Around 160,000 vehicles cross it each day.
data.title: Harbour Bridge

data.content: Crews repaint the steel arch continuously ; one full coat takes about ten years . The arch rises 134 metres above the water.
data.title: Maintenance

data.content: Tolls are collected electronically in both directions.
data.title: Tolls

data.content: The bridge was designed by a team led by John Bradfield. Its granite pylons carry no load.
data.title: Design
